posts.headline: Getting your hands dirty...
posts.post_text:
Getting your hands dirty...

Its so much more rewarding than you might expect

Having a go at building/fixing something while trying to find the resources somewhere in your house is next level fun

The engineering side of things doesn't get enough credit This might be where the real fun is!

p.s if anyone wants to lend me a drone let me know 😁

posts.headline: The bread or the key?
posts.post_text:
The bread or the key?

Everyone sees this a little different.

The explanation I like the most is the bread is tangible. He can grab it, and it feeds him straight away. It's the quick, safe choice.

The key is the unknown. Who knows what happens once that door swings open? Is it a risk your willing to take?

Having a startup feels the same way. Stepping into the unknown, unaware of all the hurdles that were coming up. Having to learn things on the go we didn't even know existed.

It's not for everybody, that's for sure. But hey, I'm more than willing to take the risk.

Everyday is something new to tackle, and I love that.

p.s the loaf of bread showing its worth in gold again  iykyk, check the kriosfounders insta ;)

posts.headline: Do random side quests with your team.
posts.post_text:
Do random side quests with your team.


Abraham and I hiked Carrountoohill at 4am the other day. Michael got scared and didn't come 🥲

These bonding moments, where we were looking at the mountains, and just discussing life, mean more than you might think.

It's important to step back from business and just say, 'how you been recently'. 

We're founders yes, but also friends, and we gotta remember that sometimes.

Check up on the people around you 🫡

p.s check out the view too

posts.headline: We're in trouble.
posts.post_text:
We're in trouble.


School starts next week.

We're switching from working solely on Kríos, to having to sprinkle in some school work :(

But we knew this was coming, and we're ready.

Is it optimal? Probably not.

But it is what it is.

One things for sure, Kríos will keep growing, and growing fast at that.

Filming in public is top 10 most embarrassing things when you first start 😂

Whipped out the camera stick and mics, and were feeling great

posts.headline: Just 3 boys with big ideas.
posts.post_text:
Just 3 boys with big ideas.

Some of the stuff we think up seem unimaginable to the people around.

And tbh, I get where they're coming from. It's not normal to do what we do.

But then again, we don't care about fitting in, or being a certain way so people like us.

We're just us, and that attracts the right people to us naturally.

Hit me up if you think you're one of them.

posts.headline: These moments>
posts.post_text:
These moments>

Kríos was made like this. Just us 3, meeting up and having laidback conversation, or so it seemed.

The work was mainly done during the night, but our daily meetups are almost just as essential.

This is when we  bounce ideas, compare what we've been working on and tackle any new issues that have come up.

Kríos is not one person. It's all 3 of us. Michael, Abraham and myself.

We're constantly in touch with each other, keeping Kríos on the right track.

That's why we move as fast as we do.
